rule: Held-out paraphrases (LOG-0037 limit 4): written once, before any run, and never used while iterating prompts, fixtures or system code. Utterances never name a capability id, package or tool; the expected capability is held by the evaluator only. A run on this set is a reported measurement and never gate evidence.
utterances: What's the next thing on my calendar?
When do I next have to be somewhere? Check my agenda.
Remind me what my upcoming appointment is.
Is there a meeting coming up for me? I only need the nearest one.
Which appointment do I have first from now on?
Please look at my schedule and tell me the earliest upcoming entry.
I need to know when my next booked engagement starts.
What have I got next in my diary?
Quando é a minha próxima reunião marcada?
¿Qué tengo a continuación en mi agenda?
